RFC9003-2-3.note: Re-read 2026-09-27. The sentence constrains the NOTIFICATION that carries a Shutdown Communication: its subcode is 2 or 4. Forbidden: ze sending a Shutdown Communication under another Cease subcode. TestRFC8203Subcode only proves the RECEIVE side (ShutdownMessage decodes for 2 and 4 and not for 3); no tagged unit asserts the subcode of a Cease NOTIFICATION ze builds with a shutdown message.

RFC9003-2-4.note: Re-read 2026-09-27. Forbidden: a receiver interpreting an invalid UTF-8 Shutdown Communication. TestRFC8203UTF8Invalid fails unless ShutdownMessage errors and returns empty for 0xff 0xfe 0xfd; TestRFC8203UTF8Valid shows valid multibyte text is interpreted.
